sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空历经七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想要看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我热爱一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nyt.com斜杠subscribe上的特惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Katrin Benholt, in for Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是卡特琳·本霍尔特，替萨布里娜·塔韦尼西主持节目。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: For months, much of the world has been watching and waiting as Ukraine prepares for a major counteroffensive in its war with Russia.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，世界各地都在注视和等待，因为乌克兰正准备在与俄罗斯的战争中发动一场重大反攻。

sentences.en: That battle is now underway.
sentences.zh: 这场战斗现在正在进行中。

sentences.en: And it's not what we expected.
sentences.zh: 而且它和我们预期的不一样。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Andrew Kramer reports from The Frontline.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安德鲁·克雷默从前线发回报道。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月23日，星期五。

sentences.en: You're 20 miles from very intense fighting after visiting The Frontline yourself last week.
sentences.zh: 上周你自己刚去前线实地探访过，距离激烈的战斗只有20英里。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您百忙之中抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来参加节目。

sentences.en: So, there's been a lot of hype around this counteroffensive.
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这场反攻，之前有很多铺天盖地的宣传。

sentences.en: When we last talked about it on the show, very little was actually known about it or the timing of it.
sentences.zh: 当我们上次在节目中讨论它时，关于它本身或具体时间其实知之甚少。

sentences.en: But in the last couple of weeks, that has began to change.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的两周里，这种情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: Can you walk us up to this moment where we're just starting to understand what we actually mean when we say counteroffensive?
sentences.zh: 你能带我们回顾到这个时刻吗？此时我们才刚开始理解，当我们说反攻时究竟意味着什么。

sentences.en: Well, the war in Ukraine had settled into a stalemate since last fall.
sentences.zh: 嗯，自去年秋天以来，乌克兰战争一直陷入僵局。

sentences.en: The armies were lined up against one another along about 600 miles of trench fortifications in southeastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 两军在乌克兰东南部大约600英里的战壕防御工事沿线对峙。

sentences.en: And it was very intense and very violent fighting, but very little ground changed hands.
sentences.zh: 那是极其激烈和暴力的战斗，但几乎没有发生领土易手。

sentences.en: The war had become a quagmire.
sentences.zh: 战争已经变成了一个泥潭。

sentences.en: So, there was a lot of pressure on the Ukrainian government to show that the policies of arming and assisting Ukraine were going to yield results.
sentences.zh: 因此，乌克兰政府承受了很大的压力，需要证明武装和援助乌克兰的政策会取得成效。

sentences.en: So, as this anticipation and hype arose about a counteroffensive, about a shift in the battlefield, this had been building for months through the winter and into the spring.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着人们对反攻、对战场转变的期待和炒作高涨，这种情绪在整个冬天和春天酝酿了数月。

sentences.en: But there was very little information about what would actually happen.
sentences.zh: 但关于实际会发生什么，信息却非常少。

sentences.en: What were they actually saying, officially, publicly, the Ukrainians, about this coming counteroffensive?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰官方和公众究竟是怎么谈论即将到来的这场反攻的？

sentences.en: Well, interestingly, they were saying almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他们几乎什么都没说。

sentences.en: Just before the counteroffensive began, the government released a video that had the sounds of crickets in the background
sentences.zh: 就在反攻开始前，政府发布了一段视频，背景里有蟋蟀的叫声，

sentences.en: and soldiers who were holding their fingers to their lips and shushing, asking for silence.
sentences.zh: 还有士兵将手指放在唇边做着嘘声的手势，要求保持安静。

sentences.en: And the video had a headline that said,
sentences.zh: 视频的标题写着，

sentences.en: Plans Love Silence.
sentences.zh: 计划渴望沉默。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's a very quiet ad, almost too quiet to hear on a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一则非常安静的广告，在播客里几乎安静得听不见。

sentences.en: And I guess that's the whole point.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是全部的重点。

sentences.en: To signal to the world, this counteroffensive is shrouded in secrecy.
sentences.zh: 向世界发出信号：这场反攻笼罩在机密之中。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: It began with such secrecy that portions of the front line were closed to journalists.
sentences.zh: 它的开始是如此保密，以至于前线的某些部分对记者关闭了。

sentences.en: The government was pleading with reporters, with society at large, not to reveal secrets about where the military would gather forces,
sentences.zh: 政府恳求记者和整个社会，不要透露军队将在哪里集结兵力的秘密，

sentences.en: where the first blows would land on the Russian line.
sentences.zh: 不要透露第一击将落在俄罗斯防线的哪个位置。

sentences.en: And in fact, when it began three weeks ago, information about this was so carefully guarded that the first we heard about it was from Russian military bloggers
sentences.zh: 事实上，当三周前战斗打响时，关于此的信息受到如此严密的保护，以至于我们听到的第一个消息来自俄罗斯军事博主，

sentences.en: who were saying that the Ukrainian counteroffensive had begun.
sentences.zh: 他们称乌克兰的反攻已经开始。

sentences.en: Only several days later, the Ukrainian government acknowledged that the initial attacks had in fact commenced
sentences.zh: 直到几天后，乌克兰政府才承认最初的进攻确实已经展开，

sentences.en: and that the Ukrainian army was on the move in several locations in southern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 并且乌克兰军队正在乌克兰南部的几个地点发起行动。

sentences.en: So at that point, did you get a sense of what the strategy was here, what the Ukrainian government's plan actually was?
sentences.zh: 那么在那时，你是否了解到了这里的战略是什么，乌克兰政府的计划到底是什么？

sentences.en: It started to come into focus when we look at a map of the south of Ukraine and we see where the military was attacking.
sentences.zh: 当我们查看乌克兰南部地图并看到军队在何处发起进攻时，这一点开始变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: They were hitting at areas of the front line that face south toward the Sea of Azov.
sentences.zh: 他们在打击面向亚速海的南部前线区域。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian strategy in the counteroffensive is to strike south and drive a wedge through Russian-occupied territory, dividing the Russian zone into two halves
sentences.zh: 反攻中的乌克兰战略是向南突击，在俄罗斯占领区撕开一个缺口，将俄罗斯控制区一分为二，

sentences.en: and cutting rail and road lines that connect Russia with the Crimean Peninsula.
sentences.zh: 并切断连接俄罗斯与克里米亚半岛的铁路和公路。

sentences.en: The idea of this strategy is a theory of victory that would cut logistical supplies to the Crimean Peninsula
sentences.zh: 这一战略的构想是一种胜利理论，旨在切断通往克里米亚半岛的后勤补给，

sentences.en: and also to everything west of where they drive this wedge through the Russian territory,
sentences.zh: 同时也切断通往他们通过俄占区撕开的这个缺口以西所有地区的补给，

sentences.en: which would probably force a retreat of Russian forces to the west of the counteroffensive.
sentences.zh: 这可能会迫使反攻以西的俄军撤退。

sentences.en: It's a theory of a step toward victory that involves crossing about 60 miles of very flat terrain from where the front line had been three weeks ago to the Sea of Azov.
sentences.zh: 这种走向胜利的理论涉及穿越从三周前的前线位置到亚速海大约60英里的平坦地形。

sentences.en: So it's kind of like a version of divide and conquer as far as the Russian-occupied territory is concerned.
sentences.zh: 所以就俄罗斯占领区而言，这有点像分而治之的变体。

sentences.en: But what do the Ukrainians actually have to face to complete the strategy?
sentences.zh: 但乌克兰人为了完成这一战略，究竟必须面对什么？

sentences.en: What essentially lies in front of them?
sentences.zh: 他们的面前究竟有什么？

sentences.en: Well, what lies in front of them are farm fields as far as the eye can see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，摆在他们面前的是一望无际的农田。

sentences.en: Very flat, open terrain, militarily extremely difficult to cross, almost impossible to find cover for armored vehicles or for troops in the open.
sentences.zh: 非常平坦开阔的地形，在军事上极难通过，在开阔地带几乎不可能找到掩护装甲车辆或部队的地方。

sentences.en: And the most difficult part is the first part.
sentences.zh: 而最困难的部分是开头。

sentences.en: The Russians have had months to prepare a very dense defensive line, which is about 10 miles deep.
sentences.zh: 俄军有几个月的时间来准备一条大约10英里纵深的极度密集的防线。

sentences.en: And this is minefields, concrete barriers for tanks, ditches that would trap armored vehicles, bunkers and trench lines for infantry.
sentences.zh: 这里布满了雷区、用于坦克的混凝土路障、旨在困住装甲车的战壕，以及供步兵使用的掩体和战壕线。

sentences.en: And this is really a kill zone the Russians have set up for the Ukrainian army that is really intended to inflict as much damage on the Ukrainian army as possible.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是俄军为乌克兰军队建立的杀戮区，其真正目的是对乌军造成尽可能大的杀伤。

sentences.en: So the first goal is to breach this 10-mile strip of Russian defenses, this kill zone.
sentences.zh: 因此，首要目标是突破这10英里宽的俄罗斯防线，即这个杀戮区。

sentences.en: What's the tactical plan to breach that?
sentences.zh: 突破它的战术计划是什么？

sentences.en: Well, in each location, it's a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在每个地方情况略有不同。

sentences.en: And one commander I spoke with compared this to a game of chess, where out on these open fields, there's sort of a checkerboard, tree lines and fields.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一位指挥官将其比作一场国际象棋，在这些开阔的田野上，有点像棋盘、林带和田野。

sentences.en: And both sides can see almost everything that the enemy is doing with their drones, with satellites, with surveillance by soldiers on the ground.
sentences.zh: 双方通过无人机、卫星以及地面士兵的侦察，几乎能看到敌人正在做的所有事情。

sentences.en: So the strategy is to find areas that might be a little bit weaker than elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以战略是寻找可能比其他地方稍微薄弱的区域。

sentences.en: In one location, for example, the Ukrainians attacked along a small meandering river, the Mokriyali River, where there are six or seven villages all in a line.
sentences.zh: 例如，在一个地点，乌克兰人沿着一条蜿蜒的小河——莫克里亚利河进攻，那里有一连串六七个村庄。

sentences.en: And by hopping from village to village, the Ukrainians could find cover in abandoned houses and move their equipment and their infantry forward into this area.
sentences.zh: 通过在村庄之间跳跃前进，乌克兰人可以在废弃房屋中找到掩护，并将他们的装备和步兵推进到这个区域。

sentences.en: So it's like they're trying to push through this Russian defense line.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像他们正试图冲破这条俄罗斯防线。

sentences.en: It's almost like they're pushing against the wall, trying with their hands in different places and identifying the weakest spot.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像他们在推一堵墙，用手在不同的地方尝试并找出最薄弱的突破口。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: That's what's happening now.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: They're probing.
sentences.zh: 他们在试探。

sentences.en: They're looking for a weakness in the Russian defensive line.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻找俄罗斯防线的弱点。

sentences.en: And right now they're doing this with only a small portion of the soldiers who have been specifically trained and equipped for the counteroffensive.
sentences.zh: 目前他们只动用了为反攻接受过专门训练和装备的一小部分士兵来做这件事。

sentences.en: Only three of 12 brigades that will eventually take part in this military action are now probing and fighting along the front line.
sentences.zh: 最终将参与这一军事行动的12个旅中，目前只有3个旅在前线进行试探和战斗。

sentences.en: And presumably when a weak spot is found, those who are in reserve will come rushing forward in a major battle to break through the Russian defenses
sentences.zh: 据推测，一旦找到薄弱点，预备队就会在一次大战中蜂拥而上，突破俄罗斯防线，

sentences.en: and then flow into southern Ukraine and advance toward the sea.
sentences.zh: 然后涌入乌克兰南部，向大海推进。

sentences.en: And it looks like it will be a very difficult and grueling battle once all 40,000 Ukrainian soldiers are engaged in the fight.
sentences.zh: 看起来一旦全部4万名乌克兰士兵投入战斗，这将是一场非常艰难和残酷的战役。

sentences.en: At that point, it could be the largest land battle in Europe since World War II.
sentences.zh: 到那时，这可能会成为自二战以来欧洲最大规模的地面战。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So how is that pushing and probing on that Russian wall going?
sentences.zh: 那么，对那堵俄罗斯墙的推挤和试探进展如何？

sentences.en: It's going very slowly.
sentences.zh: 进展非常缓慢。

sentences.en: Even President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has acknowledged that it's going slower than desired.
sentences.zh: 就连总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基也承认，进展比预期的要慢。

sentences.en: In some areas now, they've moved about four miles into the zone, and that's where the fighting is taking place now.
sentences.zh: 目前在某些地区，他们已经向该区域推进了大约四英里，激战正是在那里进行着。

sentences.en: It's been a very difficult fight.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常艰难的战斗。

sentences.en: It's lethally dangerous.
sentences.zh: 极其危险致命。

sentences.en: One of the biggest challenges in this area are minefields.
sentences.zh: 这一地区最大的挑战之一就是雷区。

sentences.en: There have been many Ukrainian soldiers who've stepped on mines.
sentences.zh: 有许多乌克兰士兵踩到了地雷。

sentences.en: According to medics, there are casualties coming out from these minefields and also Western equipment that's blowing up on the minefields.
sentences.zh: 据医疗人员称，不断有伤员从这些雷区撤下来，也有西方装备在雷区上被炸毁。

sentences.en: It strikes me that this feels almost reminiscent of, you know, past European wars.
sentences.zh: 我感觉这几乎让人想起，你知道的，过去的欧洲战争。

sentences.en: I mean, we've heard so much about this advanced Western weaponry that the Ukrainians have asked for and received, but this sounds almost like a 20th century land war.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们听了太多关于乌克兰人索要并获得的先进西方武器的讨论，但这听起来几乎像是一场20世纪的地面战争。

sentences.en: Well, it certainly looks that way when you're out along the front line.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你身处前线时，确实看起来是这样。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons is that neither side has air superiority.
sentences.zh: 原因之一是双方都没有制空权。

sentences.en: So the Russians can fly right up to the front line, and the Ukrainians can as well.
sentences.zh: 所以俄军可以飞到前线附近，乌克兰人也可以。

sentences.en: But neither side can really use fighter aircraft or helicopters to fly over the minefields, over the trenches, and attack the enemy.
sentences.zh: 但双方都无法真正使用战斗机或直升机飞越雷区、飞越战壕去攻击敌人。

sentences.en: So in this sense, it's definitely a fallback to mid-20th century land warfare in Europe.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，这绝对是倒退回了20世纪中期欧洲的地面战争模式。

sentences.en: So this sounds like it's a real slog.
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一场真正的苦战。

sentences.en: It's going very slowly.
sentences.zh: 进展非常缓慢。

sentences.en: And Andrew, you've been spending time on this front line with some of the soldiers.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，你一直和一些士兵在前线度过时间。

sentences.en: What's your sense of what morale is like at this point?
sentences.zh: 你对目前的士气有什么看法？

sentences.en: It was my sense that some of these soldiers, at least, or many of them were quite motivated, and not least because soldiers who are fighting in this offensive
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，这些士兵中的一部分，或者说他们中的许多人斗志相当昂扬，这很大程度上是因为参加这次进攻的士兵

sentences.en: are internally displaced people who've been pushed out of their home villages and towns in southern Ukraine and are now fighting to liberate them.
sentences.zh: 都是流离失所的人，他们被赶出了乌克兰南部的家乡村镇，现在正为解放它们而战。

sentences.en: I met with some soldiers at a picnic table a few miles back from the front line out in a field where they were resting and talked about how the fight was going
sentences.zh: 我在距离前线几英里外野外的一张野餐桌旁见了一些正在休息的士兵，我们聊了聊战斗的进展

sentences.en: and what their motivations were.
sentences.zh: 以及他们的动力是什么。

sentences.en: And this is what I was told, that they were very intent on reclaiming this land.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们对我说的话，他们收复这片土地的意愿非常坚定。

sentences.en: And the military, though it had initially been very secretive about its plans, about two weeks into the fighting, there was a shift and they started to open up access.
sentences.zh: 虽然军方最初对其计划高度保密，但在战斗大约两周后，情况发生了转变，他们开始放开采访权限。

sentences.en: And I was able to go into one of these liberated villages and see what it actually looked like firsthand.
sentences.zh: 我得以进入其中一个被解放的村庄，亲眼看看它究竟是什么样子。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的文字连连看益智游戏，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作拼字蜜蜂和方块填字游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉症的奇妙现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏由刚才你听到的那些有血有肉的人制作。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nyt.com斜杠games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: Andrew, take us to that Ukrainian village you visited that had just been liberated.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，带我们去你访问过的那座刚刚被解放的乌克兰村庄看看。

sentences.en: And tell us about that trip.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那次行程。

sentences.en: It began on the Ukrainian side of the former front line.
sentences.zh: 这一切开始于前线原址的乌克兰控制区一侧。

sentences.en: The photographer, David Guttenfelder, and I got in an American armored vehicle, an MRAP, a very large, bulky truck with lots of armor.
sentences.zh: 摄影师大卫·古滕费尔德和我坐上了一辆美国装甲车，一辆MRAP，那是一辆装甲厚重的庞大笨重卡车。

sentences.en: It takes about 10 or 15 minutes to drive from the front line into one of these liberated villages, villages of Bakadatne.
sentences.zh: 从前线开车到这些被解放的村庄之一，也就是巴卡达特内村，大约需要10到15分钟。

sentences.en: You zigzag across swampy fields around a blown-up bridge.
sentences.zh: 你需要在炸毁的桥梁周围的沼泽田野中呈之字形穿梭。

sentences.en: The vehicle at times accelerates.
sentences.zh: 车辆有时会加速。

sentences.en: It's a little bit hard to see what's going on outside the windows.
sentences.zh: 很难看清窗外发生了什么。

sentences.en: You just see some destroyed houses going by.
sentences.zh: 你只能看到一些被毁坏的房屋从眼前掠过。

sentences.en: And these vehicles, these MRAPs, which the Ukrainians used to drive in and out of some of the liberated areas, are very large and easy targets.
sentences.zh: 这些MRAP装甲车是乌克兰人用来进出一些被解放地区的交通工具，体积非常庞大，容易成为目标。

sentences.en: So when we arrived...
sentences.zh: 所以当我们抵达时……

sentences.en: I got you.
sentences.zh: 我掩护你。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 走。

sentences.en: Let's go, let's go.
sentences.zh: 快走，快走。

sentences.en: The back door opened, and we had to immediately run out and run away from the vehicle and into the village.
sentences.zh: 后门打开了，我们不得不立即跑出去，远离车辆，跑进村子里。

sentences.en: Pramo, pramo, pramo, pramo.
sentences.zh: 向前，向前，向前，向前。

sentences.en: So suddenly you're in the middle of the fight.
sentences.zh: 所以你突然就置身于战斗之中了。

sentences.en: And after you emerge from that vehicle and get to safety, what do you see?
sentences.zh: 在你从那辆车里出来并到达安全地带后，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: What are your first impressions of that town?
sentences.zh: 你对那个城镇的第一印象是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it was overgrown.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那里杂草丛生。

sentences.en: I can see that many of the fruit trees in the yards had limbs blown off from shelling, and every house that we passed had some sort of damage.
sentences.zh: 我看到院子里的许多果树枝干被炮火炸断，我们经过的每一座房子都有某种程度的损坏。

sentences.en: Either it was burned or the roof had been blown to pieces from artillery.
sentences.zh: 要么是被烧毁了，要么是屋顶被火炮炸得粉碎。

sentences.en: So it was an abandoned place, very eerie,
sentences.zh: 所以那是一个被废弃的地方，非常诡异，

sentences.en: either quiet or with the sounds of explosions.
sentences.zh: 要么一片死寂，要么伴随着爆炸声。

sentences.en: It wasn't what you would expect of perhaps a liberated territory where people would be greeting the soldiers or there would be some happy moments
sentences.zh: 这并不是你对解放区的期望，人们本该在那里迎接士兵，或者会有一些快乐的时刻，

sentences.en: for the Ukrainian forces that had entered this area.
sentences.zh: 对于进入这个地区的乌克兰军队来说。

sentences.en: It was very, very, very tense and very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 局势非常、非常、非常紧张，也极其危险。

sentences.en: So it was sort of liberated in name, but ultimately the atmosphere was different.
sentences.zh: 所以它算是在名义上解放了，但归根结底，氛围完全不同。

sentences.en: It was ultimately a destroyed village, a village in rubble.
sentences.zh: 这里最终是一个被摧毁的村庄，一片废墟中的村庄。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was completely destroyed and abandoned.
sentences.zh: 它被彻底摧毁并荒废了。

sentences.en: Where we were in Blokodatne, on the southwestern side of the village, there was an open field and then some reedy swamps and the river.
sentences.zh: 在我们所在的布洛霍达特内，村庄的西南侧，有一片开阔地，接着是一些芦苇沼泽和河流。

sentences.en: That was essentially the new front line, was some several hundred yards in that direction on the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 那基本上就是新的前线，在镇边缘那个方向的几百码外。

sentences.en: Some of the detritus of Russian positions were seen.
sentences.zh: 能看到一些俄军阵地留下的残骸。

sentences.en: You could see trenches.
sentences.zh: 你能看到战壕。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians had captured some machine guns, trophy weapons from the Russian forces that had been just pushed out of that village recently.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人缴获了一些机枪，这是从最近刚被赶出那个村庄的俄军手中缴获的战利品武器。

sentences.en: You would see garbage the Russians had left behind and some of their personal belongings, such as wrappings for Russian military rations.
sentences.zh: 你会看到俄罗斯人留下来的垃圾和一些他们的私人物品，比如俄军军粮的包装袋。

sentences.en: I found a pornographic book called
sentences.zh: 我发现了一本色情书刊，叫作

sentences.en: The Machine of Love, left by a Russian soldier.
sentences.zh: 《爱的机器》，是一个俄罗斯士兵留下的。

sentences.en: And there was graffiti scrawled into the walls of the houses.
sentences.zh: 房子的墙壁上还涂鸦着乱七八糟的字画。

sentences.en: I saw one was a Russian Orthodox prayer.
sentences.zh: 我看到其中一个是东正教的祈祷文。

sentences.en: There were also nicknames of soldiers and dates and the numbers of their units when they had been there.
sentences.zh: 还有士兵的昵称、日期以及他们驻留此地时的部队代号。

sentences.en: And it's an interesting artifact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很有意思的历史物件。

sentences.en: A little bit of the spirit of the Russian troops that had recently left lingered in this graffiti.
sentences.zh: 这些刚刚撤离的俄军士兵的一点精神，还在这处涂鸦中若隐若现。

sentences.en: We've seen this in many areas that have been liberated by the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 我们在乌克兰人解放的许多地区都见过这种情况。

sentences.en: Often it's very angry.
sentences.zh: 通常里面充满了愤怒。

sentences.en: It's taunting the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 这是在嘲讽乌克兰人。

sentences.en: It's threats against them.
sentences.zh: 这是对他们的威胁。

sentences.en: But there are also sometimes apologetic notes.
sentences.zh: 但有时也会有道歉的字条。

sentences.en: Some Russian soldiers have written on walls,
sentences.zh: 一些俄军士兵在墙上写道：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, or I don't understand what I'm doing here.
sentences.zh: “对不起”，或者“我不知道自己在这里做什么”。

sentences.en: That's wild.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It kind of reminds me of something that the Russians did when they marched into Berlin and liberated Berlin at the end of World War II.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起二战结束时，俄军开进并解放柏林时做过的一些事情。

sentences.en: You can still see the graffiti of these Russian soldiers at the time in the German parliament today when you take a tour.
sentences.zh: 今天当你去参观时，依然可以在德国议会大厦里看到当年这些俄军士兵的涂鸦。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was a bit fresher.
sentences.zh: 这个更新鲜一些。

sentences.en: But there wasn't much time to linger and look at these details because the village was in the sights of Russian artillery and it was very much still in the fight.
sentences.zh: 但没有太多时间去逗留和端详这些细节，因为这个村庄在俄罗斯火炮的瞄准镜内，战斗依然非常激烈。

sentences.en: And this is what the soldiers had confronted when they came into the village.
sentences.zh: 这也是士兵们进入村庄时所面对的情况。

sentences.en: And did you get a chance to talk to any of these troops?
sentences.zh: 你有没有机会和这些部队交谈？

sentences.en: Did they sort of tell you what it had been like to retake this village, what the battle had felt like, how long it went on for?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有跟你讲讲夺回这个村庄是什么感觉，这场战斗体验如何，持续了多久？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我聊过。

sentences.en: I talked to one of the commanders with a Ukrainian unit who had come in with the assault troops and retaken the village and then was based there
sentences.zh: 我跟乌克兰部队的一位指挥官聊过，他随突击部队一同进入并夺回了村庄，随后就驻扎在那里，

sentences.en: while trying to stabilize this part of the front line.
sentences.zh: 同时试图稳定这一段前线。

sentences.en: He was speaking in a darkened room where he was on his walkie-talkie dealing with various situations including while we were there one of the MRAP armored vehicles
sentences.zh: 他当时在一间昏暗的屋子里说话，正用对讲机处理各种情况，在我们呆在那里的同时，其中一辆MRAP装甲车

sentences.en: was destroyed by a grenade drop from a Russian drone.
sentences.zh: 就被俄罗斯无人机投掷的手榴弹给炸毁了。

sentences.en: He was in between dealing with these small crises which were coming up minute to minute.
sentences.zh: 他要在这些接踵而至的微小危机之间腾出精力来处理。

sentences.en: He was saying that this was an existential fight for Ukrainians, that he felt that he had lived his life in a worthwhile way for being involved in this combat
sentences.zh: 他说，对乌克兰人来说这是一场生死存亡之战，他觉得为了参与这场战斗并夺回村庄而度过的一生是很有价值的，

sentences.en: and recapturing the village.
sentences.zh: 并且夺回了这个村庄。

sentences.en: And also that when he came in and saw these gardens and these village homes that he had a sense that they were certainly Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 他还说，当他走进来看到这些菜园和村里的房屋时，他有一种强烈的感触，觉得它们绝对是乌克兰的。

sentences.en: He saw his own culture,
sentences.zh: 他看到了自己的文化，

sentences.en: Ukrainian culture in this agrarian village in eastern Ukraine although he was from the western part of the country.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰文化就存在于乌克兰东部的这个农业村庄里，尽管他来自这个国家的西部。

sentences.en: We asked the commander how he thought the war would end and he said it was going to be a very difficult fight that the Russians were dug in and they had lots of time to prepare
sentences.zh: 我们问这位指挥官他觉得战争会如何结束，他说这将是一场非常艰难的战斗，俄罗斯人已经构筑了坚固的工事，他们有充足的准备时间和

sentences.en: and lots of ammunition but that ultimately the Ukrainian army would continue to advance.
sentences.zh: 大量的弹药，但乌克兰军队最终会继续推进。

sentences.en: He thought the war would still be going on by the end of this year.
sentences.zh: 他认为到今年年底战争仍在继续。

sentences.en: But in the end that the Ukrainians would prevail in pushing Russian forces out of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但最终乌克兰人将在把俄军赶出乌克兰这件事上取得胜利。

sentences.en: And then he said that God would punish the Russians and the Ukrainian army would do the same.
sentences.zh: 然后他说上帝会惩罚俄罗斯人，乌克兰军队也会这么做。

sentences.en: And in a way it's worth stopping for a moment and remembering that Ukraine is fighting the Russian army.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我们值得花一点时间停下来记住，乌克兰正在与俄罗斯军队作战。

sentences.en: And at the very least for the moment they're not losing.
sentences.zh: 至少就目前而言，他们没有输。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What you see in this village is the Ukrainians now moving forward now on the offensive against the army that had been considered the second most powerful army in the world and now
sentences.zh: 你在在这个村庄看到的是，乌克兰人现在正在向前推进，现在正在对那支曾被认为是世界第二强大军队的军队发起进攻，而现在

sentences.en: it's stepping back even if in small ways but stepping back in front of a Ukrainian attack that the hope is in Kiev at least that this will continue through the summer
sentences.zh: 它正在后退，哪怕是以微小的方式，但在乌克兰的进攻面前后退了，基辅至少希望这能持续到夏天，

sentences.en: and they will be able to push the Russians back into the sea.
sentences.zh: 并且他们将能够把俄罗斯人赶回海里。

sentences.en: And this was one thing that the soldiers I talked to both in this village and elsewhere were joking the next time I'll see you
sentences.zh: 我采访过的士兵，无论是在这个村庄还是其他地方，都在开玩笑说：“下次我见你时，

sentences.en: I'll see you on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我就会在海滩上见你了。”

sentences.en: But this was just one village to advance to the Sea of Azov they'll need to capture dozens or hundreds of villages like this.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一个村庄，要想推进到亚速海，他们需要攻占几十个甚至几百个这样的村庄。

sentences.en: They'll need many small victories like this.
sentences.zh: 他们需要很多这样的小胜利。

sentences.en: And I couldn't help thinking what was in front of them and it was not a joyous moment because on the one hand they had reclaimed the village on the other hand
sentences.zh: 我不禁在想摆在他们面前的是什么，这不是一个令人高兴的时刻，因为一方面他们收复了村庄，另一方面

sentences.en: this had just turned them into a target for Russian artillery and Russian attack helicopters.
sentences.zh: 这也让他们成了俄罗斯火炮和俄罗斯攻击直升机的活靶子。

sentences.en: So it was almost a metaphor for the counter-offensive that every step forward would become one step toward a more difficult task ahead for the Ukrainian army.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎是反攻的一个隐喻，即前行的每一步都意味着乌克兰军队前方将面临更艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: So in a way what you're seeing there in this tiny village on the Ukrainian front line sums up the paradox of this moment that Ukraine is putting up an incredible fight
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，你在乌克兰前线的这个小村庄里看到的一切，总结了这一时刻的悖论，即乌克兰正在进行一场令人难以置信的战斗，

sentences.en: but that every gain is excruciating and incremental.
sentences.zh: 但每一次进展都是极其痛苦和微乎其微的。

sentences.en: And that if we thought this counter-offensive was going to be this fast and furious blitzkrieg we were wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果我们认为这场反攻会是一场如此快速而猛烈的闪击战，那我们就大错特错了。

sentences.en: Well that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，完全正确。

sentences.en: When President Zelensky was talking recently about the counter-offensive he said this would be a slow fight and then he went even further than that he said that
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统最近在谈到反攻时表示，这将是一场缓慢的战斗，然后他更进一步地说，

sentences.en: it's not going to be a Hollywood movie it's not going to follow a script that would be pleasing for people who are watching this.
sentences.zh: 这不会是一部好莱坞电影，也不会遵循让观看者感到满意的剧本。

sentences.en: It would be very difficult there would be lots of casualties and he said that a good portion of the Western weaponry there's billions of dollars of armored vehicles
sentences.zh: 这将非常艰难，会有大量人员伤亡，他说，提供给乌克兰军队的价值数十亿美元的装甲车、防空系统和榴弹炮等西方武器中，

sentences.en: and air defense systems and howitzers that have been given to the Ukrainian army will be destroyed just moving through these first miles.
sentences.zh: 有很大一部分在穿过这最初的几英里时就会被摧毁。

sentences.en: And he said that what's at stake here is the lives of his soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他说，这里危及的是他士兵的生命。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我做客。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 今天早上，来自“北极地平线”号船只的遥控潜水器（ROV）

sentences.en: Horizon Arctic discovered the tail cone of the Titan submersible approximately
sentences.zh: 在海底发现了“泰坦”号潜水器的尾锥，

sentences.en: 1,600 feet from the bow of the Titanic on the sea floor.
sentences.zh: 距离“泰坦尼克”号船首大约1600英尺。

sentences.en: In a news conference on Thursday the United States Coast Guard said it had found debris of the deep-sea submersible that went missing on Sunday and that all five people
sentences.zh: 美国海岸警卫队在周四的新闻发布会上表示，他们已经找到了周日失踪的深海潜水器的残骸，据信船上的五名人员

sentences.en: aboard are believed to be dead.
sentences.zh: 已经全部遇难。

sentences.en: On behalf of the United States
sentences.zh: 我谨代表美国

sentences.en: Coast Guard and the entire
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队和整个

sentences.en: Unified Command I offer my deepest condolences to the families.
sentences.zh: 联合指挥部，向遇难者家属致以最深切的哀悼。

sentences.en: I can only imagine what this has been like for them.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法想象这对他们来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: Coast Guard officials said it appeared that the vessel whose safety had been repeatedly questioned by many experts had imploded during the expedition.
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队官员表示，这艘安全性能一再受到许多专家质疑的潜水器在考察过程中似乎发生了内爆。

sentences.en: When asked whether the bodies of the victims could be recovered the Coast Guard said it was unlikely.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否能找到遇难者遗体时，海岸警卫队表示不太可能。

sentences.en: This is an incredibly unforgiving environment down there on the sea floor.
sentences.zh: 海底的环境极其残酷无情。

sentences.en: For decades the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。
